name: yt-error
description: YT TError JSON envelope; body of every error response, mirrored in X-YT-Error header; nested via inner_errors.

fields.name: code
fields.description: numeric YT error code; the mock uses 1 (generic, incl. wrong-password /login, matching the real proxy), 500 (resolve/NODE_DOES_NOT_EXIST), and mock-only 900/901 for API-command auth/CSRF failures. The real proxy uses native auth codes such as 111/110 for cookie-auth failures

name: whoami-response
description: Body of GET /auth/whoami — the identity/CSRF endpoint used by cluster bootstrap and, when password auth is enabled, by UI-server request authentication.

fields.name: csrf_token
fields.description: must be truthy or UI blocks with PRELOAD_ERROR.AUTHENTICATION; re-sent as X-Csrf-Token for credentialed requests, while the wrapper omits it when cluster authentication is 'none'

name: web-json-response
description: read_table response body in output_format web_json (the table viewer format).

fields.name: all_column_names
fields.description: sorted ascending; drives the column selector

fields.name: yql_type_registry
fields.description: only with value_format: yql; UI works without it (schemaless mode)

name: web-json-cell
description: Scalar cell encoding inside web_json rows (value_format schemaless).

fields.name: $incomplete
fields.description: set when value truncated by field_weight_limit; mock never truncates

name: table-schema-column
description: One column in the @schema attribute ({$attributes: {strict, unique_keys}, $value: [columns]}).

fields.name: type
fields.description: legacy type (int64, string, double, boolean, any)

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: 'ascending' on key columns; drives key icons and @key_columns

fields.name: required
fields.description: UI renders it when present; mock omits

name: cluster-info-response
description: Body of GET /api/cluster-info/:cluster (UI server; fans out to proxy /auth/whoami + /version). A truthy version and token.csrf_token are required for a successful mount, but failed upstream calls omit token/version and populate the corresponding error field.

fields.name: token
fields.description: proxied /auth/whoami body; required for a successful mount

fields.name: version
fields.description: raw proxy /version text ('mock-proxy-1.0.0' in the mock); bootstrap checks only that it is truthy

name: cluster-params-response
description: Body of GET /api/cluster-params/:cluster (UI server; two execute_batch calls against the proxy). Each field is a batch item {output?} | {error?}.

fields.name: mediumList
fields.description: list //sys/media; a present error aborts cluster init — MUST succeed

fields.name: schedulerVersion
fields.description: get //sys/scheduler/orchid/service/version; mock 500 -> UI falls back to '0.0.0-unknown'

fields.name: masterVersion
fields.description: version string from the first primary master; when the primary-master list is empty, the list batch item is returned instead (output: [] in the mock)

name: clusters-config-entry
description: One cluster in the UI server's clusters-config.json (server-rendered into window.YT.clusters; no /clusters endpoint exists).

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: host:port of the HTTP proxy — points at the mock

fields.name: authentication
fields.description: 'none', 'basic', or 'domain'; omitted values default to 'none', and the UI otherwise only tests !== 'none'

fields.name: disableHeavyProxies
fields.description: true -> UI server never calls /hosts for heavy commands

fields.name: primaryMaster
fields.description: cellTag etc.; not needed by the viewer

fields.name: requests
fields.description: sub-commands dispatched against the same command table

fields.name: output_format
fields.description: governs the OUTER envelope; annotate_with_types wraps every scalar as {$type,$value}

name: execute-batch-result-item
description: One element of the execute_batch response list, in request order.

name: login-request
description: Password login: browser POSTs JSON to UI server /api/yt/:cluster/login; UI server converts to HTTP Basic and calls proxy POST /login; empty 200 + Set-Cookie YTCypressCookie (no SameSite), duplicated as <cluster>_YTCypressCookie by the UI server.

fields.name: username
fields.description: checked against users map in data.js

fields.name: password
fields.description: plain password; a wrong pair returns HTTP 401 with generic code 1 ('Incorrect login or password'), matching the real proxy which masks the cause
